Hi Dev and Grace,

Quick note — our Vanta contract is up for renewal in May and Legal asked us to run a short evaluation against Trust Center and Drata so we can justify the spend and check if switching vendors makes sense. I put together a one-page evaluation matrix (attached) that compares cost, SOC2 automation coverage, evidence collection, and SSO integration.

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-03-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor selection: Trust Center / Vanta renewal evaluation and next steps

Marissa — thanks for the matrix, looks clean. A few quick notes: 

- Agent model: Trust Center's agentless collectors look promising but for some on-prem workloads we still prefer an agent to capture OS-level configs and custom services. If Trust Center can do a hybrid deployment (agent for on-prem, agentless for cloud) that's fine.
- Data flows: ensure both vendors can exclude tokens/PMI from logs; we need explicit support for redaction and scoped logging.
- Integrations: Vanta's Azure AD + GCP connectors are mature; for our VPC Private deployment we need SAML + SCIM support for automated user provisioning.

If Legal needs an architecture note I can draft a short appendix on where an agent would run and the network egress constraints.

- Dev
